build_detic_cascade_roi_heads: build a DeticCascadeROIHeads model with 1203 classes and zero-shot CLIP classifier for LVIS detection
configure_detic_fast_rcnn_output: configure DeticFastRCNNOutputLayers with zero-shot classification, sigmoid CE loss, and image label loss
setup_custom_train_loader: setup a custom training dataloader combining LVIS and ImageNet datasets with multi-dataset sampling
configure_zero_shot_classifier: configure a ZeroShotClassifier using CLIP weights for 1203 LVIS classes with normalized weights
setup_lvis_evaluation: setup an LVISEvaluator for evaluating detections on the LVIS validation dataset
